text: The Medical Officer of Health will give a presentation on the 2019 Toronto Public Health Preliminary Operating Budget: New and Enhanced Funding.

The Board of Health Budget Committee: 1. Directed the Medical Officer of Health to submit a 2019 Operating Budget request that: a. includes in the 2019 cost-shared base budget for Toronto Public Health the additional 2018 provincial funding over and above the City of Toronto approved budget for provincially cost-shared programs, resulting in a gross budget of $172,071.1 thousand gross and $43,017.8 thousand net; b. includes all of the proposals listed in Confidential Attachment 1 to the presentation (July 18, 2018) from the Director, Finance and Administration, Toronto Public Health, with the exception of Proposal 4; and c. includes the following new and enhanced services for cost-shared programs: a. $1,660.5 thousand gross, $415.1 thousand net available for new and enhanced opportunities. 1. $1,308.0 thousand gross for the annualized cost for the opportunities presented in the 2018…
